name: Veil-ian #04
description: A veiled figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Flat cap. Aperture: Slot. Ornament: Concentric squares. Palette: Gold + lilac. Hem: Ragged. Its palette is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
